profile.headline: Software Developer @ Deloitte | MSCS student at Georgia Tech
profile.summary:
I am a graduate of Penn State University, holding a B.S. in Mathematics and a minor in Computer Science. 

Over the past few years of my degree, I have greatly evolved my passion for Mathematics and Computer Science. Since my first year at Penn State Harrisburg, I have gotten the opportunity to participate in Astrophysics research in an associated lab of the High Altitude Cherenkov Observatory. Through this experience, I have gained applied skills in programming and data analysis as well as soft skills in presentation and scientific communication. I have also gained industry experience in software development through my internship with Deloitte Consulting, LLC. 

Going forward, I am looking for opportunities that will further push me in these areas. I hope that I will be able to solve interesting problems using logic and ingenuity.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: I provided tutoring to students of Penn State Harrisburg in the areas of Math and Computer Science.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Undergraduate research assistant in astrophysics lab. My role included programming and data analysis.

positions.title: Penn State Physics and Materials Science REU
positions.description: Undergraduate research experience in astrophysics. I had the opportunity to work full-time in a university lab for the summer.

positions.title: Summer Solution Scholar (Software Developer)
positions.description: I spent the summer working on a professional development team. I developed and maintained documentation for a multi-stage data migration, as well as an issue tracker.
positions.insights: Written Communication, Computer Science and +1 skill
